name: test-utils
title: Test utils
description: Testing Library helpers that skip UI SDK's live regions: getToast, queryToast, queryToasts, queryAlerts, queryStatuses, isAnnouncer, ignoreAnnouncer, readAnnouncements and resetAnnouncer.
docs: For tests only. UI SDK announces through two hidden live regions in <body> (`role="status"` and `role="alert"`, marked `data-ui-sdk-announcer`) that keep the last text they announced, so `getByRole("alert")` and `getByText` can find them after a toast has closed. Find toasts with `getToast(text)` or `[data-slot="toast"]`, query inside `within(screen.getByRole("region", { name: "Notifications" }))`, pass `{ ignore: ignoreAnnouncer }` to text queries, and call `resetAnnouncer()` in `afterEach`.
